correctness.rationale: Exact unit-speed quadrant chart gives L=6 and intrinsic baseline epsilon/3. Same-quadrant extrinsic shortcuts have O(epsilon^2) measure by a bounded-total-turning estimate. At each opposite cusp pair exact distance scaling yields the bounded parabolic-cusp region and Jacobian epsilon^(5/3); integrating it produces C=(2^(1/3)/9)B(1/3,3/2), with eight ordered branch contributions. L1 convergence gives the conditional total-variation law and Beta(1/3,3/2) times uniform marks. The standalone exact finite-radius quadrature passes the specified checks; numerics are not used as a proof.
